trap-nonspeakable.notes: TWO MATH FLAGS (not traps, reported not fixed). (1) TYPE MISMATCH: 'Geometrically, [X,P]_q equals Theta(xi_q), the q-deformed Reeb field evaluated on the contact form.' Theta(xi_q) is a SCALAR function, while the left side is an operator valued in J hbar_q per prop:heisenberg-commutator. Also, for a genuine Reeb field the contact normalisation is Theta(xi) = 1 identically, so the quantity can only interpolate 0 -> J if xi_q is left unnormalised - which the next sentence half-concedes by defining xi_q only as 'the unique DIRECTION along which dTheta degenerates', i.e. up to scale. State the normalisation that fixes the scale. (2) 'As q -> infinity ... d_q -> pi_V . d' holds on HORIZONTAL forms only: d_q -> Theta wedge L_xi in that limit, and Theta wedge L_xi alpha = Theta wedge iota_xi d alpha = pi_V(d alpha) requires iota_xi alpha = 0, since L_xi = iota_xi d + d iota_xi. Worth stating the restriction.
